Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BID ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 1. The bidder should be OEM or Authorized by OEM for this bid and should upload BID specific authorization from OEM (Signed & Stamped copy) along with bid do cuments. 2. The bidder/OEM should have executed project for supply of Fire Suppression System equipment/ Batteries in past through GeM with completion certificate (C RAC Certificate) and same should be uploaded at the time of bid submission. 3. The bidder/OEM must submit valid NABL-accredited laboratory test reports for fire suppression system product with 02 Kg & 10 Meter heat sensing tube as p er mentioned in Bid and same should be upload at the time of bidding.

4. The bidder must quote and participate for all items/products mentioned in the bid. Any bidder who fails to quote for all products shall be marked as disqualifie d and the bid will be rejected. 5. Test certificates and warranty/Guarantee certificates to be submitted at the ti me of delivery. 6. OEM should be registered in State Pollution Control Board and ISO-9001 Certifi cate within the last one year from the bid submission date and the same should be uploaded while submitting the bid otherwise bidder will be rejected. 7. GST Registration Certificate if already obtained by the bidder. Or If the bidder has not obtained GST registration as applicable, then he shall scan and upload following undertaking on a Non Judicial Stamp Paper of R s.100/-, duly notarized, along with bid documents, “If work is awarded to me, I/we shall obtain GST registration certificate, as applicable, within one month from the date of receipt of award letter or before release of any pa yment by CPWD, whichever is earlier, failing which I/we shall be responsib le for any delay in payments which will be due towards me/us on account of the work executed and/or for any action taken by CPWD or GST depart ment in this regard". 8. Freshness Certificate: All batteries supplied must be recent manufacture. T he date of manufacture should not be older than 6 months from the date of delivery. A manufacturing “Freshness Certificate” must be provided at the time of supply. 9. Warranty: The units shall carry a comprehensive onsite replacement warra ny of at least 24 moths (or as per OEM standard, whichever is higher) from the date of installation. The bidder shall submit OEM warranty certificate at the time of supply. 10. Testing; post-installation, a load-bank test or backup-time verification must be demonstrated to the consignee to ensure the AH capacity meets the sy stem requirements. 11. Data Sheet: Bidders must upload the original OEM Technical Data Sheet cl early highlighting the C-20 rating and container material (FR-ABS) of SMF B attery. 12. If bidder is re-seller must upload OEM authorization certificate against the specific bid with undertaking ready to provide good within stipulated time period as prescribed in bid document. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): The intending bidders shall submit the EMD i n favour of the Executive Engineer (E), ECD-III, CPWD, New Delhi, in the fo rm of a Demand Draft (DD), Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR), or Banker’s Cheque. A scanned copy of the EMD shall be uploaded on the GeM Portal at the time of bid submission . 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
